description:
Look up what anyone can see on Beleeg — a league, team, match or tournament public page — no membership needed. Read-only. Pick `what` and give the slug or id listed for it.

what (params; ? = optional):
- league: A league's public page by its slug: sport, current season, teams, standings. [slug]
- team: A team's public page by its slug: roster, captain, colours, recent matches. [slug]
- match: One match by match_id: teams, lineups, set scores, venue. [match_id]
- tournament: One tournament's public page by tournament_id: status, entrants, bracket. [tournament_id]
- league_tournaments: The tournaments a league shows the public, by the league slug. [league_slug]

league_slug.description: Public league slug (not UUID). Used with what: league_tournaments.

match_id.description: One match id (from what "schedule"). For the match-day lookups, leave out to mean the person's next match. Used with what: match.

slug.description: Public URL-safe league slug. Used with what: league, team.

tournament_id.description: A tournament id, from what "tournaments". Used with what: tournament.

what.description: What to look up. Every value is listed, with its params, in the tool description.

name: beleeg_look_up_public
title: Look up a public page
